mapper.select: insert into inv_trx (comp_cd, plant_cd, trx_type, item_id, node_id, lot_id, stock_status, qty, unit_cd, move_grp_id, src_type, src_id, reason_cd, remark, client_req_id, req_seq, occurred_at, entry_method, recorded_by, performed_by, reversal_of_id, po_line_id, po_qty) values (hb_current_comp(), #{plantCd}, #{t.trxType}, #{t.itemId}, #{t.nodeId}, #{t.lotId}, #{t.stockStatus}, #{t.qty}, #{unitCd}, #{t.moveGrpId}, #{t.srcType}, #{t.srcId}, #{t.reasonCd}, #{t.remark}, #{clientReqId}, #{reqSeq}, #{t.occurredAt}, #{t.entryMethod}, #{by}, #{t.performedBy}, #{reversalOf}, #{t.poLineId}, #{t.poQty}) returning trx_id
select trx_id from inv_trx where client_req_id = #{clientReqId} order by req_seq
select req_seq, trx_type, item_id, node_id, stock_status, qty, lot_id, src_type from inv_trx where client_req_id = #{clientReqId} order by req_seq
mapper.sql: t.trx_id, t.lot_id, (select l.lot_no from lot_master l where l.lot_id = t.lot_id) as lot_no, t.plant_cd, t.trx_type, t.item_id, i.item_cd, i.item_nm, t.unit_cd, t.node_id, n.node_cd, wms_node_path(t.node_id) as path, t.stock_status, t.qty, t.move_grp_id::text as move_grp_id, t.src_type, t.src_id, t.reason_cd, t.remark, t.occurred_at, t.recorded_at, t.entry_method, t.recorded_by, t.performed_by, w.worker_nm as performed_by_nm, t.reversal_of_id, (select r.trx_id from inv_trx r where r.reversal_of_id = t.trx_id) as reversed_by_id, t.po_line_id, t.po_qty, t.client_req_id
from inv_trx t join mst_item i on i.item_id = t.item_id join mst_equip_hier n on n.node_id = t.node_id left join mst_worker w on w.worker_id = t.performed_by
mapper.select: select where t.trx_id = #{id}
select where t.move_grp_id = #{moveGrpId} order by t.trx_id
mapper.sql: item_id, item_cd, item_nm, spec, unit_cd, lot_ctrl_yn, use_yn
mapper.select: select from mst_item where item_id = #{id}
select from mst_item where item_cd = #{itemCd}
mapper.sql: n.node_id, n.node_type, n.node_cd, n.node_nm, wms_node_path(n.node_id) as path, coalesce(a.loc_usage, 'STORAGE') as loc_usage, a.default_status, coalesce(a.stock_yn, 'Y') as stock_yn
mapper.select: select from mst_equip_hier n left join wms_loc_attr a on a.node_id = n.node_id where n.node_id = #{id} and n.plant_cd = #{plantCd} and n.node_type in ('WH', 'LOC') and n.use_yn = 'Y'

select , exists (with recursive up as ( select x.node_id, x.parent_id, 1 as lv from mst_equip_hier x where x.node_id = n.node_id union all select p.node_id, p.parent_id, u.lv + 1 from up u join mst_equip_hier p on p.node_id = u.parent_id where u.lv < 20) select 1 from up join wms_loc_attr s on s.node_id = up.node_id where s.loc_usage = 'SCRAP') as under_scrap from mst_equip_hier n left join wms_loc_attr a on a.node_id = n.node_id where n.plant_cd = #{plantCd} and n.node_type in ('WH', 'LOC') and n.use_yn = 'Y' order by case when a.loc_usage = 'RECEIVING' then 0 else 1 end, 5, n.node_id
select plant_cd from mst_equip_hier where node_id = #{id}
select exists (select 1 from sys_plant where plant_cd = #{plantCd})
select exists (select 1 from sys_code where grp_cd = #{grpCd} and code = #{code} and use_yn = 'Y') or exists (select 1 from sys_comp_code where grp_cd = #{grpCd} and code = #{code} and use_yn = 'Y')
select coalesce((select mix_item_yn from wms_loc_attr where node_id = #{nodeId}), 'Y')
select exists (select 1 from inv_stock where node_id = #{nodeId} and item_id <> #{itemId} and qty > 0)
select coalesce((select qty from inv_stock where item_id = #{itemId} and node_id = #{nodeId} and lot_id is null and stock_status = #{status}), 0)
select from mst_equip_hier n left join wms_loc_attr a on a.node_id = n.node_id where n.plant_cd = #{plantCd} and n.node_type in ('WH', 'LOC') and n.use_yn = 'Y' order by path

select s.node_id, n.node_cd, wms_node_path(s.node_id) as path, s.stock_status, s.qty from inv_stock s join mst_equip_hier n on n.node_id = s.node_id where s.plant_cd = #{plantCd} and s.item_id = #{itemId} and s.qty > 0 and s.lot_id = #{lotId}s.lot_id is null order by path, s.stock_status
mapper.sql: s.stock_id, s.plant_cd, s.node_id, n.node_cd, wms_node_path(s.node_id) as path, s.item_id, i.item_cd, i.item_nm, i.spec, i.unit_cd, s.lot_id, lm.lot_no, s.stock_status, s.qty, s.last_trx_id, s.updated_at
from inv_stock s join mst_item i on i.item_id = s.item_id join mst_equip_hier n on n.node_id = s.node_id left join lot_master lm on lm.lot_id = s.lot_id

order by
path lm.lot_no s.qty s.updated_at i.item_cd
desc,
s.stock_id

with p as materialized ( select h.node_id, wms_node_path(h.node_id) as path from mst_equip_hier h where h.plant_cd = #{q.plantCd} and h.node_type in ('WH', 'LOC')) select s.stock_id from inv_stock s join mst_item i on i.item_id = s.item_id left join lot_master lm on lm.lot_id = s.lot_id join p on p.node_id = s.node_id
order by
p.path lm.lot_no s.qty s.updated_at i.item_cd
desc,
s.stock_id limit #{q.page.size} offset #{q.page.offset}
mapper.select: select from () k join inv_stock s on s.stock_id = k.stock_id join mst_item i on i.item_id = s.item_id join mst_equip_hier n on n.node_id = s.node_id left join lot_master lm on lm.lot_id = s.lot_id
select count(*)
select
select from inv_stock s join mst_item i on i.item_id = s.item_id join mst_equip_hier n on n.node_id = s.node_id left join lot_master lm on lm.lot_id = s.lot_id where s.stock_id = #{id}
mapper.sql:
order by
t.trx_id t.occurred_at
desc,
t.trx_id desc
mapper.select: select set_config('plan_cache_mode', 'force_custom_plan', true)
select from () k join inv_trx t on t.trx_id = k.trx_id join mst_item i on i.item_id = t.item_id join mst_equip_hier n on n.node_id = t.node_id left join mst_worker w on w.worker_id = t.performed_by
select count(*)
select
mapper.sql: from (select item_id, node_id, lot_id, stock_status, sum(qty) as q from inv_trx group by item_id, node_id, lot_id, stock_status) t full join inv_stock s on s.item_id = t.item_id and s.node_id = t.node_id and s.lot_id is not distinct from t.lot_id and s.stock_status = t.stock_status where coalesce(t.q, 0) <> coalesce(s.qty, 0)
mapper.select: select count(*) from inv_stock

select coalesce(t.item_id, s.item_id) as item_id, coalesce(t.node_id, s.node_id) as node_id, coalesce(t.lot_id, s.lot_id) as lot_id, coalesce(t.stock_status, s.stock_status) as stock_status, coalesce(t.q, 0) as ledger_qty, coalesce(s.qty, 0) as stock_qty
order by 1, 2 limit #{limit}
select count(*)

insert into inv_reconcile_run (comp_cd, key_count, mismatch_count, missing_receipts, rcv_mat_over, rcv_po_mismatch, qc_judged, qms_void_live, detail, run_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{keys}, #{mismatches}, #{missing}, #{rcvOver}, #{poMismatch}, #{qcJudged}, #{voidLive}, #{detail}::jsonb, #{by}) returning run_id

select run_id, run_at, key_count, mismatch_count, missing_receipts, rcv_mat_over, rcv_po_mismatch, qc_judged, qms_void_live, detail::text as detail, run_by from inv_reconcile_run order by run_at desc, run_id desc limit 1
select from (select i.*, count(*) over () as n from mst_item i where lpad(btrim(i.attrs ->> 'GTIN'), 14, '0') = #{gtin}) x where n = 1
select lot_no from lot_master where lot_id = #{lotId}
select t.trx_id, l.lot_no from inv_trx t join lot_master l on l.lot_id = t.src_id where t.client_req_id = #{reqId} and t.req_seq = 1 and t.trx_type in ('RCV_MAT', 'RCV_PO')
select count(*) from ( select t.src_id from inv_trx t join lot_master l on l.lot_id = t.src_id where t.src_type = 'MAT_RECEIPT' group by t.src_id, l.qty_created having sum(t.qty) > l.qty_created ) x

select count(*) from srm_po_line p left join (select t.po_line_id, sum(t.po_qty) as q from inv_trx t where t.po_line_id is not null group by t.po_line_id) x on x.po_line_id = p.po_line_id where coalesce(x.q, 0) <> p.recv_qty
select cust_cd from mst_cust where cust_id = #{custId}
select lot_id from lot_master where lot_id in #{id} order by lot_id for share
